title: Bookkeeper
description:
Our client are an independent firm of Chartered Accountants serving owner-managed businesses across Cheshire and the surrounding area.

The important client work you will be doing:

You will be managing the books for a genuinely varied portfolio of owner-managed businesses - from trades and hauliers to farmers and consultants. No two clients look the same, and that's exactly how we like it. One day you might be reconciling a courier company's fuel and vehicle costs, the next you could be getting your head around farm income or a consultant's project-based invoicing.

You will be working mainly in Xero, so you should be comfortable and confident in it day-to-day. We also work with clients on other platforms, so a working knowledge of alternatives (QuickBooks, Sage, FreeAgent or similar) will really help.
- You can actually do the job - accurately, independently, with support from your colleagues when needed.
- You are comfortable switching between different types of business and different ways of working.
- You take pride in getting the numbers right, not just done.
- You fit with how we work: independent, personal, straightforward.

What's on offer:
- £26,000 - £35,000+
- A good mix of clients from a range of sectors and the chance to broaden your technical experience.
- Direct support and regular review from experienced client managers.
- Ongoing training, and support for further professional study and progression.
- Flexi-time working arrangements.
- A friendly, independent firm where your contribution is visible and valued.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper

We're working with a well-established and friendly accountancy practice in Chester that is looking to add an experienced Bookkeeper to its growing team.

- Excellent communication skills and a client-focused approach
- The ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities effectively

What's on Offer?
- Salary up to £32,000 depending on experience
- Permanent, full-time position
- Friendly and supportive team environment

- Excellent office location in Chester
- Opportunities to develop your skills and progress your career within a growing practice

Interested?

If you're an experienced Bookkeeper with accountancy practice experience and CIS knowledge, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today to find out more about this fantastic opportunity in Chester.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Accountable Recruitment are delighted to be partnering with a growing and well-established business who are seeking to appoint an experienced Credit Controller to join their finance team.

Based in the Chester area, this is a fantastic opportunity for an experienced credit professional looking to join a fast-paced environment and take ownership of a high-volume debtor ledger.

Salary/Benefits:
- £30,000 - £35,000 DOE
- Permanent, full-time position
- 37.5 hour working week, Monday to Friday
- Opportunity to work within a growing multi-entity business environment

Job Duties:
- Manage the debtor ledger, ensuring invoices are collected within agreed payment terms and bad debt exposure is minimised.
- Work towards monthly cash collection and receivables targets while maintaining accurate records.
- Investigate, manage and resolve aged debt cases and customer account queries.
- Support cashflow forecasting and reporting on debt provisions and receivables performance.
- Assist with accounts receivable administration, including invoice and credit note processing.
- Handle inbound and outbound customer communications via telephone and email.
- Work closely with teams across Finance, Sales and Operations to resolve account issues and improve collections performance.
- Support internal and external audit requirements where necessary.

Ideal Experience:
- Previous Credit Control experience within a high-volume environment.
- Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable processes and debtor ledger management.
- Experience working within construction, manufacturing, distribution or similarly fast-paced sectors would be advantageous.
- Confident communicator with excellent customer service and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Competent Microsoft Office and general IT skills.
- Experience working across multiple entities and currencies would be beneficial.
- AAT qualification desirable but not essential.

This role would suit an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys building relationships, driving cash collection performance, and working collaboratively across a busy finance function.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator

Cheshire - Office Based

Are you a highly organised administrator with experience in finance operations, invoicing or transactional processes?

We're working with a successful and growing Cheshire-based organisation looking to add a Finance Administrator to its established finance team.
